article.title: Experience As a Whole: Expanding the Boundaries of Cultural Strategy
article.author: Evan Bissell
article.content: Just as sunlight on a sunny morning isn’t experienced as separated wavelengths and colors, we don’t live our lives as beings split into economic, cultural and political parts. For those of us working primarily with and through culture, how does this shape our work?
